$comment: Static inventory. No external schema file is published yet (NO_DATA); the contract is validated by tests/mcp_manifest.test.mjs.
title: PreceptorOS · theGame · Full Node action manifest
declaration: Static inventory only. No network, no personal data, no runtime discovery. The web receives nothing from anyone (Reglamento (UE) 2024/1689 transparency-by-design, Art. 50).

actions.title: Summon a wave (TC1)
actions.what: Opens the summon sheet and preselects treasure class TC1. The act itself still needs the player's Ed25519 signature; the link only lands on the exact card.
actions.needs: visitor key (created on device, never leaves it)
actions.cost_measured: 50 cobre per attempt (motor resource, game cycles; measured in values.js)
actions.evidence: ui-invoca.js invoca(tc); summon-access.js reuses live summon buttons

actions.title: Workshop · dissolve a wave into residue
actions.what: Opens the Workshop on the dissolve step. Dissolving gives static residue (1 g per edge, three times for a Leviathan). Nothing is bought.

actions.title: Workshop · sand a stat
actions.what: Opens the Workshop on the sanding step. Raises one stat, costs residue, never adds edges.
actions.cost_measured: residue g, rising per level (measured: taller.js)

actions.title: Move the lighthouse (Hexelion)
actions.what: Focuses the camera/lighthouse control on Hexelion destinations list.

actions.title: Transparency log (radio channels)
actions.what: Opens the communication panel on the sealed log channel. Echoes/chat subchannels are NO_DATA and say so.

actions.title: Create your visitor key
actions.what: Scrolls focus to the key creation control at the top of the page. Private key never leaves the device.
actions.evidence: Workshop acts refuse unsigned visitors: taller_sin_id message

global_guards.no_network: The web performs zero new network requests; the rack pushes receipts to the repo (G4, separate piece).
global_guards.no_personal_data: No personal data in this manifest. Coordinates are in-world only.
global_guards.a11y: Mouse, keyboard, touch; world audible; controls >= 44 px.
global_guards.determinism: Same seed and input = same result; the suite can go red.
global_guards.piece_budget: Each piece < 16 KiB, vanilla JS, no build in public/.

open_firmos: receipt date: UTC or game cycles? (Soberano decides)
receipt push identity: receipts branch only, never main direct (Soberano decides)
